reviews.text: We went with a hamster, he was really not feeling well (our doctor was on vacation). The doctor sent me away, saying to wait for the doctor, he wouldn't interfere in the treatment. There was no examination or treatment, we weren't there for 5 minutes, yet the full examination fee was charged. Previous experience, not this one.
We went to see Dr. Gyula Molnár with my sick chinchilla. He was kind and empathetic. He answered all my questions kindly and in detail. I wholeheartedly recommend him to everyone. ❤️
Great place.😃The doctor is very professional, thorough, and cute.😃
We were very satisfied with them, they were thorough, kind, the examinations covered everything and the Dr. explained everything clearly.

Our cat's dental care deserves 5*. We have been to several places with her tooth resorption disease, here we felt the safest both professionally and personally. They pay attention to supporting anxious animals, Dr. Papp explains everything in detail, they have dental X-rays. This is the first place where I got my cat back after surgery so that she was eating and in a good mood the same day.👌🏼

My 15-year-old FIV+ cancer survivor cat had to have her remaining teeth extracted. This treatment had been postponed for the past 2 years due to the cat's other problems, but it was finally necessary this February. I was looking for a doctor who specializes in small animal dentistry and who is careful about anesthetizing an elderly cat.

Dr. Georgina Papp operated on the cat. The surgery itself went well, she was careful with the anesthesia, the doctor performed the procedure thoroughly, and we quickly got an appointment with the university, which would have been the other option. That's about all the positives.

I had to beg for the bills: it took several emails and daily phone calls to get them sent, before I paid several hundred thousand forints. I had to beg for the dental X-ray and even the price quote; I received the quote for the surgery worth several hundred thousand the day before the surgery. The doctor said it, sent it, but it was still dated later. I spoke to others who had the same experience with this doctor. She didn't apologize, in fact, it was as if I had bothered them.

The style was also not appropriate. The doctor made several comments that the cat should have been taken earlier because of its teeth, while we clearly discussed that due to the kitten's condition, several specialists agreed (2-month check-ups!), we postponed this. There was treatment, education; once I asked about something a second time, she replied: "You asked this last time, and I told you then too...". After a while, it was unpleasant to contact her.

The most serious problem was that she was stubbornly refusing to remove the stitches, when the kitten had already been disturbed to the point that it had become lethargic and not eating. My kitten has half a liver due to a tumor, and not eating and losing weight is life-threatening. I called her in tears, but she kept referring to the risk of anesthesia, while the two-hour surgery itself didn't bother her that much. She referred to the fact that the kitten maintains its weight, but even laypeople know that not eating for 24 hours is a big risk to a kitten's liver, even when there is no visible weight loss. In my desperation, I emailed Dr. Dunay from the university, who told me that in such cases, the standard procedure is to remove the stitches, even in old animals.

Finally, another veterinarian removed the stitches, and my kitten got better in a few days.

For the above reasons, I do not recommend them at all, and due to the unnecessary stress they caused us, I cannot rate this service any higher. In retrospect, I really regretted choosing this clinic and doctor. Someone else could have performed the surgery, but perhaps it would have included correct billing, more empathy, and taking the owner seriously — for this much money.

Additional. after the answer: it's true, what I call an invoice above is the medical record, which contains the prices in detail + the expert opinion. We received the terminal bill, the detailed one was missing. We had to beg 2 times out of 3 times: for the very first one, which also included the price quote (which we did NOT receive verbally, I forgot to ask, the doctor may have forgotten to tell me, no problem, but it was difficult to get the info afterwards, I called the reception desk several times for this), then for the post-surgery one, which was really stressful, I was worried about the x-rays that they would be lost.

As far as we know, the doctor did not discuss suture removal with the oncologist, but came up with another "action plan" to NOT remove them - we let this go. This was 21 days after the surgery, according to others, the suture can be removed on the 10th-14th day, so twice the recommended time has passed. The steroid was minimal, in the past starvation and stress were the greater risk (we don't even know about recurrence).

It's true that I had the vet's number, but after a while I didn't have the confidence to contact her.

Update: our kitten died unexpectedly 2 months after the procedure. He was old and had a complicated history, I'm not blaming him, BUT: his labs were improving before the surgery; after the surgery, the values ​​deteriorated dramatically. The weight loss and the continuous stress that went beyond what was justified, which the vet exposed Tony to by not taking him seriously, certainly didn't help. Sometimes I think that if he had been shown to someone else who took us seriously and was willing to work with us, then maybe Tony wouldn't have endured the romping that would have cost him so much.

Incredibly professional office, thorough doctors. They explained every result/test in detail (they called me on a separate phone), I was calm and they took their time. They treated the dog kindly and attentively. We received detailed information before anesthesia and they checked everything afterwards to make sure everything was okay.
I can only recommend it!
Professional care and humane attitude.

There are very few, very cute, but I don't like the money orientation. I went with a puppy with a problem, I definitely need four preventive examinations, only after that can anesthesia and a treatment that I didn't ask for, but they think is necessary, 200 thousand. I didn't use it in the end, then 20 thousand how did they look at it. The same day, another doctor examined it in another place and solved the problem for 16 thousand forints, the dog didn't have to be anesthetized unnecessarily.

I would react to their answer: they couldn't have known that the tooth was broken, since no x-ray was taken, it was a tip and that's why they wanted the whole procedure. As it turned out at the other doctor, it wasn't broken, it came out loosely, with intact roots, the tooth didn't have a hole either. Luckily, I didn't subject the dog to unnecessary anesthesia.
They are very conscientious about dealing with sick animals.

I highly recommend it!
All the staff take care of the patients in a nice, calm environment with lots of love and professional knowledge. Thank you very much for making our elderly dog ​​healthier and happier!💝🐶 …

We have been coming here since the clinic opened, and we can say with all our hearts that we would not want to go anywhere else. The staff here are, without exception, extremely kind, helpful and direct, and their professional knowledge is outstanding in every aspect. Every time we feel that they really pay attention to us and our cats. They always answer our questions with great patience, thoroughly and clearly. During the examinations, it is clear that for them the pet is not just a “case”: they look into everything, look for the cause of the problems, and we always receive a well-thought-out, detailed treatment plan. It is especially reassuring that we are not left alone after the treatment – ​​the follow-up also works excellently. It feels good to know that our cats are truly in the best possible hands.

A couple of weeks ago we started taking our guinea pig to Dr Papp Georgina. I've had experience with many recommended vets (for guinea pigs), but I think she is the best. Kind, conscientious and honest. Beyond being highly skilled, she thoroughly analyzes your case and determines the right treatment. Highly recommended.
Started taking our guinea pig a couple of weeks ago to Dr Papp Georgina. I've had experience with many recommended vets (for guinea pigs), but I think she is the best. Kind, conscientious and honest. Beyond being highly skilled, she thoroughly analyzes your case and determines the right treatment. Highly recommended.
"Customer" treatment ☆☆☆☆☆
Our 14 year old puppy had his teeth pulled because they were in bad condition. They were very thorough and kept our dog safe during the 2.5 hour surgery. I highly recommend them!

We came across the clinic "by chance". I was looking for a clinic where they could see me at short notice because of a forgotten vaccination.
The lady was incredibly helpful on the phone, and we got an appointment for the same day. Sushi is so scared of the vet's clinic every time that he trembles for days afterwards, so we have to go back. We are infinitely satisfied with the environment, the expertise, the helpfulness, the treatment, everything. In the person of Dr. Vivien Valkovszki, we met a determined, experienced and consistent Doctor, who kindly addressed Sushi at every moment of the examination.
Sushi's previous fear was replaced by a pee of joy, which is rare even in everyday situations, let alone in a vet's clinic. I am glad that we found the CsudaVet team. We wish everyone such a caring environment and Doctors as we had.

They are more like salespeople than doctors. They are terribly money-oriented, have zero empathy. They are not very professional either, our female kitten was classified as a male kitten by the vet there. Now that she started to heat up, it turned out that she is a girl. We did not have the neutering done here, because they said it would have cost almost 100,000 HUF for a male kitten, because of this kind of examination, that kind of examination, etc... Instead, we got away with less than a third of that, and in return we got a good doctor who is 100x more professional than anyone here. We will never come here again, because the whole thing is a complete rip-off....

Positive: they accepted me immediately in an emergency, expertise. Negative: they are terribly money-oriented, if your animal suddenly gets into trouble, at least 150-200 thousand HUF should be in your pocket immediately, because there is no subsequent or installment payment. They prefer not to perform important, life-saving examinations, treatments, or prescribe medication if you cannot pay immediately. The animal is not the first, not at all. Just as I transferred the minimum allowed 26 thousand HUF backlog afterwards, I would have paid for the other examinations as well. Lack of empathy, tattooed assistant and the receptionist grinning at me because I cried for my cat? If you can't treat an animal as a family member in a veterinary office, I think you should go and get a haircut, because you don't belong there.
professional, kind

I went to them for months with a dog with intestinal disease and it was treated so badly with antibiotics that it developed serious intestinal problems....
It's funny that people would leave so much money behind just to let an unfortunate dog suffer for the rest of its life....

Today, my Mandarin cat and I had our first dental check-up at CsudaVet, as the cat has been struggling with dental problems since the beginning of the year. I would also like to specially mention the doctor and the assistant, as I have never met such kind and dedicated staff when I took my cat to the vet. They treated the animal kindly and with complete dedication, and my cat felt like she was at home, not just another problematic animal. The doctor acted completely correctly, informing me about the costs of the expected treatments and what interventions my cat will likely face in the future. Of course, such interventions are quite expensive, but they give you the opportunity to think in advance about whether you are willing to pay for them. I believe that the administrative staff also handle incoming calls and emails with complete care and quickly, and are open to finding solutions to any problems that arise.

Everyone is amazing, my bunny received absolutely comprehensive and professional care, and I received detailed information about everything.
They are very kind, and it is clear that they care about pets.
The best possible.
We take our rabbits to them, they examine them very carefully, and we receive appropriate information about possible prevention and possible treatment.
We went to Dr. Gyula Molnár's for the first time with my dwarf hamster Dzsungi. He is a very kind, attentive, sweet and thorough doctor ❤️ I recommend him to everyone 🙏 …

I have never written a review before, but this one blew my mind.
We wanted to get our kitten neutered and we made our choice based on a very fair price and good reviews on the website. When we made an appointment by phone, they informed us that a lab test was mandatory, but they didn't say anything more specific, they just gave us an appointment.
As we went with our kitten, they started examining it, checked its teeth and weighed it, etc. (for 16 thousand forints) and then AFTER that they informed us that the rest of the examination would be more than 150 thousand forints... okay?
I ask... IF the "small" lab test is MANDATORY, shouldn't the huge cost of this be stated somewhere?? Poor cat traveled for more than 40 minutes for nothing and now we have to look for a new doctor for its health...
The health of the kitten is the most important thing, but the mismanagement of the first owners at this level... is incomprehensible.

We have visited the office with two different problems so far (both problems required multiple visits), and in both cases we have only had positive experiences with the doctors, assistants and receptionists. Our dog is extremely sensitive, reactive to dogs, so it was a huge relief that when we said this in advance on the phone, they immediately knew what it meant and paid attention to it so that we could go in without him meeting other dogs. This has happened every time so far.

We first sought out Dr. Georgina Nagy for a dental examination. At that time, we looked for a lot of pain in the dog that could be behind his behavioral problems, which the doctor was completely understanding about. During the examination, she took the time to get to know and connect with the dog, and during the examination, she tried to cause the animal as little stress and discomfort as possible, trying to cooperate with him and with us throughout. For the dental calculus removal under anesthesia, they did an ultrasound and a blood test, and at our request, they also checked a few extra things (also for pain research). The doctor was so thorough that she took an X-ray of the dog's teeth to be on the safe side, and found a hidden tooth that was lying crosswise under the gum and could potentially press on the root of the tooth next to it, so she operated on it. After the anesthesia, the dog was quickly brought out so that he could wake up with us, while the doctor showed and thoroughly explained everything that happened and what to do next. In addition, she even recommended insurance for us so that we could reduce the costs of the dental visit.

For the second time, we visited the office with symptoms of intestinal inflammation, and we ended up with Dr. Valkovszki Vivien. When I called them, based on the symptoms, we got an appointment for the same afternoon, when we met with the same kindness and cooperation as before (both with us and the dog). The doctor was incredibly thorough, kind and helpful, she initially recommended conservative therapy, but also said that if it didn't work, we could go in a different direction. Unfortunately, the next day the dog got worse, I called them when they opened, and they told us to go immediately, they would see us. The doctor examined the dog again, and based on the examination and symptoms, she recommended an infusion, blood tests and an ultrasound, which they did that day. That afternoon, as soon as the results arrived, she called to inform me about them, which was very reassuring. We went back in the evening to get the dog, who seemed to be doing better, and they also made friends with the assistant :) We had an infusion today, he also examined her today, and even recommended food to support the dog's digestion in the next month, which I am especially grateful for, because choosing food can be an endless black hole for me :D We still have to take the dog to the infusion for a few more days, but it is already clear how he is slowly building up little by little.

In both cases, we were met with enormous patience and kindness, I received thorough answers to all my questions, and they never made me feel like I was asking too much or something stupid.

I have seen several people write that they think the practice is only about money, and I would like to write here that although such a circle of veterinarians can be very expensive, in both cases we dealt with extremely empathetic, careful, knowledgeable and animal-centric professionals, and (with a lot of superficial, bad veterinary experience behind us) I think it is much more likely that what some consider unnecessary examinations can save lives in some cases. I am absolutely sure that the practice is driven by cooperative healing and thoroughness. Also, we should not forget that those who deal with dogs here (we have no experience with other animals here, but I think it is likely that this is the case with other species) understand dog behavior much better than an average veterinarian, and this is a huge value when an animal has to be examined and treated while it is already unwell and stressed.
Very kind doctors, I recommend them wholeheartedly

I can only recommend the kind, conscientious Doctor Gyula Molnár as an exotic pet doctor. I received extensive information about the health status of my pets, their proper care and nutrition. The assistants and the receptionist are also very kind and helpful. I wholeheartedly recommend Csudavet!
I am grateful to the doctors, they were endlessly patient with my anxious/panicking dog. The place is friendly, there is no hospital atmosphere at all. The prices are fair.
They proved once again that it is worth bringing our sensitive dog here. Dr. Valkovszki Vivien and her assistant were very patient, professional, and flexible throughout. Thank you very much ❤️
Prepared, qualified doctors. Attentive and friendly attitude towards both our cat and us. I recommend!

I have a very bad experience. I do not recommend it to anyone. The doctor's only motivation was to make as much money as possible, even at the expense of the animal's health. Basic setup: we went for a combined vaccination with a healthy 3-month-old puppy.
- He examined the ears of a 3-month-old puppy with an ultrasound device without reason, which later cost us 6,000 forints
- He gave me a drontal and a heartworm pill at the same time with the advice to give both at the same time to a 3-month-old dog!!! Why do we treat a dog for heartworm in December??
- he said to feed only dry food, wet food is not good for the dog
- he claimed that the dog is allergic because his skin is red (???) so it would be best if I immediately switched to hypoallergenic food, which of course I can buy from him
- finally, after 1 hour of examination, we reached the place where we went to vaccinate him, then with a filled syringe in his hand he said, sorry, there is no combination vaccine yet, I will only give parvo and he vaccinated him before we blinked
- in the end we paid 40 thousand forints for the vaccination of a puppy, so after the more than 1 hour procedure we waited outside for another 15 minutes for the bill but the receptionist said that the doctor had not prepared it yet
- that's why we paid without a bill, we received the bill 1.5 hours after leaving, then we saw the horror amounts that he unnecessarily charged us. Since then, we paid 10,000 forints for the vaccination at the other place and they gave him a full examination for free!!!
Since then, two other doctors have seen the dog and he has a new permanent doctor. I emphasize the medical opinion: there is nothing wrong with his ears, he is not allergic, his skin is fine, the doctor said that it would have been a huge mistake to feed him dry food and hypoallergenic food. Since then, I have been feeding him the same way with a variety of quality wet and dry food. Since he missed his vaccination schedule, we had to take him to get vaccinated 2 more times. Heartworm treatment should only be started during the mosquito season and it is forbidden to give the two together!!! If we listen to the doctor, today I have a sick, over-medicated, mistreated puppy accustomed to the expensive hypoallergenic food from the expensive doctor.
It is a shame that such a doctor can practice.
I filed a complaint with the chamber with the two medical opinions. I hope there will be consequences.
They are my favorites...I hear so many good things about them that I proudly bring them.

I am very happy to have found this clinic. I have never met such a kind, conscientious team. I just took my cat for vaccinations and I also received a very thorough examination for free, which I have never had anywhere else! The prices are also very friendly. From now on, we will only come here!
Dear conscientious doctors. They thoroughly examined the little patients. It's very far from us, but I'd be happy to bring our pets here if they get sick.

They are very much into sales, that's my impression. I was shocked to read that in response they posted on the internet for the world to see what my pet's name was, when we visited them and described in detail what the problem was! Aren't veterinarians bound by confidentiality??? I did not consent to this data being shared with the world, please delete it, it's a violation of my privacy.
Thank you.
(By the way, we visited there three times, not once)
